surfaces.name: Watch channels
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Channels row of the watch start screen; the watch page explains the list in its channels entry.

surfaces.name: Watch audio player
surfaces.reason: Opened by a channel of the watch list; the watch page explains the player in its player entry.

surfaces.name: Watch video player
surfaces.reason: Opened by a channel of the watch list; the watch page explains the player in its player entry.

surfaces.name: Watch broadcast
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Broadcast row of the watch start screen; the watch page explains it in its broadcast entry.

surfaces.name: Watch broadcast QR code
surfaces.reason: Opened by Show QR code on the watch broadcast screen; the watch page explains it in its qr entry.

surfaces.name: Watch tile channel
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Choose tile channel row of the watch start screen; the watch page explains it in its tile entry.

surfaces.name: Watch channel pictures
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Channel pictures row of the watch start screen; the watch page explains it in its pictures entry.

surfaces.name: Channel actions
surfaces.reason: Opened by the More button of a channel row; the catalog page explains each action of the sheet in its channel-actions entry.

surfaces.name: Recently played
surfaces.reason: Opened from one menu entry of the catalog; the catalog page explains it in its recently-played entry.

surfaces.name: Sleep timer
surfaces.reason: Opened by the timer button of the radio bar; the catalog page explains it in its sleep-timer entry.

surfaces.name: Import playlist
surfaces.reason: A one-field dialog opened from one menu entry of the catalog; the catalog page explains it in its import-playlist entry.

surfaces.name: Import live broadcast
surfaces.reason: Opened from one menu entry of the catalog; the catalog page explains its three ways in the import-broadcast entry.

surfaces.name: Change password
surfaces.reason: A three-field dialog opened by Change password on the account card; the exchange page explains it in its change-password entry.

surfaces.name: Connection check
surfaces.reason: Opened by Why won't it connect? on the exchange screen and by a failed connection; the exchange page explains it in its diagnose entry.

surfaces.name: Media exchange and broadcasts
surfaces.reason: A menu: a list of portal topics, each of which opens its page in the system browser, and its names say where they go (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Broadcast password
surfaces.reason: A one-field password prompt for a protected broadcast; its text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Help
surfaces.reason: The help viewer itself; the page it shows is the help.

surfaces.name: Exchange import
surfaces.reason: A translucent hand-off that reads one shared file or text, shows at most one message and finishes at once; it draws no screen of its own.

surfaces.name: Broadcast entry
surfaces.reason: A hand-off from the launcher shortcut, tile and widget that opens Broadcast Control and finishes at once; it draws no screen.

surfaces.name: Broadcast share
surfaces.reason: A hand-off that opens Broadcast Control and finishes at once; it draws no screen.

surfaces.name: Channel tile launch
surfaces.reason: A translucent hand-off from the channel tile widget that starts playback and finishes at once; it draws no screen.
